4. Coordinate with other documents: Your will should work seamlessly with any existing estate planning documents such as a power of attorney, healthcare directive, or living will. 5. Review and update regularly: Estate laws change frequently, so it's crucial to review and update your will periodically to ensure that it remains effective and compliant with current regulations.
